title: Intent v1 (frozen at W1, wired to truth at W2)
description: What the brain may answer with on POST /v1/decision. Structured intents only - never CLI strings (EXECUTION.md frozen contract). Whitelist = the human-player action space; addstat / tile edits / friendship-value edits are forbidden. W1 middleware executes only declare_war; the rest are reserved until W2/W4.

actorCivID.description: Must be a registered CivAgent seat; gateway rejects human seats

chatText.description: Diplomatic line accompanying the intent; W3 chat flow reuses this

trade.description: Required for propose_trade / buy_luxury. One open trade per civ pair (W4 slot). Amounts validated by the engine: amount <= treasury; money never appears from nowhere.

intel.description: Required for share_intel (W5): text claim first; never writes into fog or tech tree

kind.description: W5.7 verification hook: war | peace | other; only war/peace claims auto-verify

aboutCiv.description: Which civ the claim is about (verification observes this civ's state)

warFocus.description: Optional strategic hint for declare_war; downgraded when target not land-reachable without navy

type.description: e.g. Gold, Gold_Per_Turn, Luxury, Strategic, Open_Borders, Embassy
